title: Allow to preselect refinements
body:
For all refinement widgets, it should be easy to automatically select refinements at start.

For example, with a menu, I should be able to say that the facet value "iphone" is selected by default.

We have had numerous users willing to do so previously and the answer we had was to use the "searchParameters".

Unfortunately there's no easy way for our users to know which searchParameters to use and what's their format given their widget.

Even if we would document it, it would look weird to have to provide a "hierarchicalRefinements: {}" because you want to preselect menu items (yes, internally menu is a one level hierarchicalRefinement).

Some of our widgets actually already implement that sort of things, like passing "min" and "max" to the rangeSlider: it defines the numeric refinement to apply.

So it needs to be a new API entry at the widgets level.

comments.body: preselecting refinements is easy in react-instantsearch, soon in IS V2
